interpretation: An unedited GUI round trip preserves the custom LTYPE definition and LINE group 6 for both ASCII and binary source files.

The unedited VENDOR_BINARY line visibly renders its [10,-5] dash pattern. The Properties panel still labels the selected entity Continuous, and its standard linetype control does not expose the imported custom name.

Two GUI move attempts lose group 6 and write ByLayer while retaining the LTYPE table. The second attempt showed both override checkboxes unchecked, but the action/slot values were not independently verified; treat it as a moved-output observation, not proof of the false-flags path.

A later scratch-only adapter control directly called RS_Modification::move with useCurrentAttributes=false and useCurrentLayer=false and passed 400 assertions. The moved clone retained VENDOR_BINARY and a nonzero line-type fold ID; export retained VENDOR_BINARY for both source and moved LINE, and the existing binary import selector passed. This narrows the unresolved loss to the GUI action/property route. The scratch test was not added to the LibreCAD source tree and does not close P8-D.
